group.name: Algorithm Module <-> Output Visualization
group.modules: linked_list / bst / graph / sorting (via processing.py)  ->  visualizer.py (render_linked_list, render_tree, render_graph, render_path, render_bars)
group.strategy: Incremental Integration: each algorithm module was connected to its renderer one at a time (list, tree, graph, path, bars) and re-tested after each addition.
group.dataPassed: LinkedList / BST / Graph objects, (distance, path) tuples and sorted lists  ->  multi-line text strings
